quotations.old_english: Ða castelmen ðe wǽron on Engla lande him togeánes cómon [MS. comen]
quotations.english: the castle-men who were in England came against him

source_text: castel-men; gen. -manna; pl. m. Castle-men; castellani :-- Ða castelmen ðe wǽron on Engla lande him togeánes cómon [MS. comen] the castle-men who were in England came against him, Chr. 1075; Erl. 213, 18.
